caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, reddish-brown terracotta pot placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pot has a slightly flared rim with a textured, beaded pattern along the edge. There is a visible hole in the bottom center of the pot, which is typical for drainage in plant pots. Various irregular, dark brown or black markings and spots are scattered around the outer and inner surfaces of the pot, suggesting a rustic or aged appearance. The pot's base is slightly raised and circular. The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner of the image. There are no additional objects or elements present in the drawing, and the composition is minimalistic, drawing attention to the details and coloration of the pot itself.
title: Pa. German Soap Dish
